name: input-group
useFor: Use InputGroup when a field needs a glyph (search), a fixed prefix or suffix (github.com/), or an action inside it (copy, send). Put InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea inside with InputGroupAddon on the side given by align; use InputGroupButton for keys and InputGroupText for words.
constraints: A main ink key inside a plain search field
source: Derived from the Hoplite website's lines, type and nav keys (.hn__top), as Input is (the site has no fields)

title: Input group
description: The square field with things inside it: a 16px Phosphor glyph, quiet text, or a compact ghost hexagon key at either end, or a row of actions above or below a textarea; hover, focus and invalid belong to the whole frame.
